confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July peak season from general knowledge and the supplied Florence and London figures; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Beer and restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are approximate (about +/-25%) because summer rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the local beer price (cocktail about 2.3x beer, wine glass about 1.1x beer) because direct knowledge of them is weaker. Assumes EUR/USD near 1.15 to 1.20. FX rate taken from RBA exchange-rate search results, not from opening the RBA table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated against the supplied Florence and London figures. Beer sits just below Florence and well below London; cappuccino sits nearer London because Viennese cafes price coffee above Italian bar prices; inexpensive meals sit below both; the mid-range dinner falls between Florence and London; hotel anchors fall within the Florence-London band. Hostel anchors sit above both comparables, set on general knowledge of Vienna's summer hostel pricing.
